title: Nvidia investing $1.5B in SoftBank data center developer behind OpenAI project
summary: Nvidia's investment in SoftBank's data center developer will guarantee its chips power an OpenAI data center.
title_es: Nvidia invierte $1.5B en infraestructura de datos para OpenAI
bajada: Nvidia invertirá $1.5 mil millones en desarrollador de centros de datos de SoftBank que abastecerá un proyecto de OpenAI, garantizando que sus chips sean el corazón de la infraestructura. La inversión refuerza la posición dominante de Nvidia en el ecosistema de IA.
bajada_en: Nvidia will invest $1.5 billion in SoftBank's data center developer that will power an OpenAI project, securing its chips as infrastructure backbone. The investment reinforces Nvidia's dominant position in the AI ecosystem.

title: Anthropic’s annualized revenue surges to $65B
summary: The model maker added $18 billion in annualized revenue in two months.
title_es: Anthropic alcanza $65B en ingresos anualizados en dos meses
bajada: Anthropic añadió $18 mil millones en ingresos anualizados en apenas dos meses, llegando a una tasa de $65 mil millones anuales. El crecimiento acelerado refleja la demanda masiva de sus modelos Claude en el mercado empresarial.
bajada_en: Anthropic added $18 billion in annualized revenue in just two months, reaching a $65 billion annual run rate. The accelerated growth reflects massive enterprise demand for its Claude models.

title: Introducing ChatGPT for Teens: Built for learning, backed by protections
summary: ChatGPT for Teens helps teens learn, think critically, and use AI with confidence, with stronger built-in protections, healthy-use features, and additional controls for parents.
title_es: OpenAI lanza ChatGPT para adolescentes con protecciones reforzadas
bajada: ChatGPT for Teens introduce controles parentales, límites de uso saludable y protecciones integradas diseñadas específicamente para usuarios menores de edad. La medida responde a la creciente preocupación sobre el impacto de la IA en menores.
bajada_en: ChatGPT for Teens introduces parental controls, healthy-use limits, and built-in protections designed specifically for younger users. The move addresses growing concerns about AI's impact on minors.

title: Groq raises $350M to fuel its pivot from AI chips to neocloud
summary: Groq raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation as the former AI chipmaker pivots to a neocloud business and expands its Nvidia-powered data center footprint.
title_es: Groq recauda $350M en su pivote hacia infraestructura en la nube
bajada: Groq, ex fabricante de chips de IA, recaudó $350 millones a una valuación de $3.5 mil millones para expandir su modelo de negocio hacia centros de datos potenciados por GPUs de Nvidia. El cambio estratégico marca un giro importante en la compañía.
bajada_en: Groq, a former AI chipmaker, raised $350 million at a $3.5 billion valuation to expand its business model toward Nvidia-powered data centers. The strategic shift marks a major pivot for the company.

title: The Powerful Chinese AI Model Experts Warned About Is Here
summary: Z.ai’s latest AI model release could help companies secure their systems—or find its way into the hands of hackers.
title_es: Modelo de IA chino Z.ai genera preocupaciones de seguridad
bajada: Z.ai lanzó un modelo de IA de peso abierto que expertos advierten podría usarse tanto para asegurar sistemas como para ataques maliciosos. El lanzamiento reaviva el debate sobre la liberación responsable de modelos potentes.
bajada_en: Z.ai released an open-weight AI model that experts warn could be used both to secure systems and for malicious attacks. The release reignites debate over responsible release of powerful models.

title: ChatGPT is getting a dedicated mode for teens
summary: OpenAI is introducing a dedicated ChatGPT mode for teenagers, combining existing youth safeguards and new safety features under one roof. The launch comes amid mounting public scrutiny over how AI tools affect younger users, as other platforms implement their own age checks and teen-specific protections. ChatGPT for Teens is "an experience designed to help teens […]
title_es: ChatGPT for Teens: modo dedicado con protecciones avanzadas
bajada: OpenAI implementa un modo dedicado en ChatGPT específicamente para adolescentes con controles de seguridad reforzados y restricciones de uso. La medida responde a la presión pública sobre el impacto de herramientas de IA en menores de edad.
bajada_en: OpenAI implements a dedicated ChatGPT mode for teens with enhanced safety controls and usage restrictions. The move responds to public pressure over AI tools' impact on younger users.

title: AI’s recursive self-improvement might not come so quickly after all
summary: The AI industry’s boldest promise right now is that AI will soon improve itself, with almost no need for human oversight. LLMs can already write code, generate synthetic data for training, and optimize the computer chips they run on. Forecasts of explosive AI progress predict that what researchers call recursive self-improvement is on the horizon. …
title_es: La mejora recursiva de IA podría llegar más lentamente
bajada: Un análisis de MIT Technology Review cuestiona la promesa de la industria sobre la mejora recursiva de IA, sugiriendo que los desafíos técnicos son mayores de lo esperado. La investigación modera las expectativas sobre el ritmo de progreso exponencial de la IA.
bajada_en: MIT Technology Review analysis challenges industry promises about recursive AI self-improvement, suggesting technical hurdles are steeper than expected. The research moderates expectations about exponential AI progress rates.

title: Partnering with CodeAI to prepare the first AI generation
summary: OpenAI and CodeAI are partnering to help students build AI literacy, think critically about AI, and develop the skills to use and shape it responsibly.
title_es: OpenAI se asocia con CodeAI para educación en IA
bajada: OpenAI y CodeAI lanzan una iniciativa conjunta para que estudiantes desarrollen alfabetismo en IA y usen la tecnología de forma responsable. El programa busca preparar a la próxima generación con pensamiento crítico sobre IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI and CodeAI launch a joint initiative to help students develop AI literacy and use the technology responsibly. The program aims to prepare the next generation with critical thinking about AI.

title: The Defender’s Window
summary: AI is reshaping cybersecurity for attackers and defenders alike. Learn how OpenAI is strengthening its defenses and what security teams can do now.
title_es: OpenAI publica guía sobre ciberseguridad en era de IA
bajada: OpenAI lanza 'The Defender's Window', un documento que analiza cómo la IA está transformando la ciberseguridad para atacantes y defensores. La publicación ofrece recomendaciones prácticas para que equipos de seguridad se preparen ante amenazas impulsadas por IA.
bajada_en: OpenAI releases 'The Defender's Window', a report analyzing how AI is transforming cybersecurity for both attackers and defenders. The publication offers practical recommendations for security teams to prepare for AI-driven threats.

title: AI automation startup Relay shuts down, staff joins Google’s Chrome team
summary: "We have some really ambitious plans to help you work with AI in Chrome to get things done, and I’ll have more to share soon," Jacob Bank, Relay founder and CEO, said.
title_es: Google adquiere startup de automatización Relay para Chrome
bajada: Relay, startup enfocada en automatización con IA, cierra operaciones y su equipo se une a Google para trabajar en experiencias de IA integradas en Chrome. El movimiento señala la estrategia de Google de potenciar su navegador con capacidades de IA.
bajada_en: Relay, an AI automation startup, shuts down and its team joins Google to work on AI experiences integrated into Chrome. The move signals Google's strategy to enhance its browser with AI capabilities.

title: We still don’t know how people are really using AI
summary: AI companies like Anthropic and OpenAI regularly publish reports on how people are using products like Claude and ChatGPT, but they only release the data they want us to see, AI researchers say.  “There is no independent source to corroborate it,” says Anka Reuel, a Computer Science PhD candidate at the Stanford Trustworthy AI Research…
title_es: Falta transparencia sobre cómo usuarios realmente usan IA
bajada: Investigadores advierten que solo vemos datos de uso que OpenAI y Anthropic deciden compartir, sin fuentes independientes para verificar. El análisis resalta la necesidad de transparencia y auditoría externa sobre adopción real de IA.
bajada_en: Researchers warn we only see usage data that OpenAI and Anthropic choose to share, with no independent sources to verify. The analysis highlights the need for transparency and external audit of actual AI adoption.

title: FLOPs vs Real Work: The Importance of Replication in AI Efficiency Assessment
summary:
arXiv:2608.14550v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: AI efficiency has recently taken the spotlight in both academy and industry due to massive model scales, high energy demands, and environmental costs. While reporting Floating Point Operations (FLOPs) is a traditional approach for assessing computational costs, the relationship between FLOPs and execution time is not straightforward, as layers with the same number of FLOPs may not have the same execution time because some operations are more easily parallelized than others. This paper sets out to replicate the original experiments from a study that proposed the $\alpha-FLOPs$ estimation formula to verify whether the results remain applicable on newer, more powerful hardware.
  During the replication process, we identify limitations in the replication materials provided by the original study, including a lack of specific dependency details and transparency regarding regression data. Our results validate the thesis that raw FLOPs alone are not an appropriate metric for execution time, as spatial dimensions remain more easily parallelized than kernel dimensions. However, fine-grained measurements reveal that the relationship is much less straightforward than previously shown, with newer hardware exhibiting instabilities and discontinuities in execution time, including jumps and oscillations, that the $\alpha-FLOPs$ formula generally underestimates. Ultimately, this work validates the empirical findings from the original study but shows negative results when applying the $\alpha-FLOPs$ estimation. We also highlight the critical need for complete and accurate replication packages for research on hardware-dependent efficiency assessment and provide a complete replication package for our implementation to facilitate further study.
title_es: Estudio: FLOPs no predicen bien rendimiento real de IA
bajada: Investigadores replican un estudio previo y confirman que contar FLOPs no es métrica confiable para predecir tiempo de ejecución en hardware moderno. El hallazgo tiene implicaciones importantes para evaluar eficiencia de modelos de IA.
bajada_en: Researchers replicate previous study and confirm that FLOPs counting is unreliable for predicting execution time on modern hardware. The finding has important implications for evaluating AI model efficiency.

title: GPT-5.6 Sol Pricing Cut by 50%
title_es: GPT-5.6 Sol reduce precio 50% en OpenRouter
bajada: El modelo GPT-5.6 Sol recibió un corte de precio del 50% en la plataforma OpenRouter. La reducción hace la API más accesible para developers que experimentan con modelos avanzados.
bajada_en: GPT-5.6 Sol model received a 50% price cut on OpenRouter platform. The reduction makes the API more accessible for developers experimenting with advanced models.

title: Google’s Pet Memory forgot who my cats are
summary: One of the best things my smart home does is help me care for my pets, and security cameras are particularly useful for keeping track of my many critters. But the barrage of notifications they send often means I miss important ones. So, when Google announced its new Pet Memory feature for Gemini for Home, […]
title_es: Google Pet Memory falla al reconocer mascotas en Gemini
bajada: La nueva función Pet Memory de Google para Gemini Home tiene dificultades para mantener información consistente sobre mascotas del usuario. El problema expone limitaciones en la memoria contextual de agentes de IA para el hogar inteligente.
bajada_en: Google's new Pet Memory feature for Gemini Home struggles to maintain consistent information about user's pets. The issue exposes limitations in contextual memory of smart home AI agents.

title: Does a Language Server Save Tokens for Coding Agents? A Measurement Methodology and Preliminary Study
summary:
arXiv:2608.13568v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Coding agents spend most of their context budget on retrieval. Lexical retrieval (grep) is universal, instant, and zero-setup, but noisy: it cannot tell a definition from a call from a comment. Semantic retrieval via the Language Server Protocol (LSP) is precise and typed, but needs a running, indexed server and pays a per-symbol round-trip. The claim that semantic retrieval is more token-efficient is, we find, asserted almost everywhere and measured almost nowhere: no public source isolates the LSP-vs-lexical token delta for an agent at equal task-success. This paper formalizes the question with one metric (tokens-to-success), specifies a five-arm ablation isolating semantic retrieval from confounds, maps three pre-stated failure modes onto measurable variables, and reports a preliminary study (Python and TypeScript repos; Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6, Haiku 4.5). The answer is conditional and usually negative. On symbol-named localization the LSP costs tokens (+6% to +118%) and the agent ignores it when free. On reference-completeness it buys precision but not token savings and cannot raise the recall ceiling set by agent thoroughness; it saves tokens only for the weakest model. Tool choice is task-dependent: models default to grep on localization (0-6% semantic use) but reach for the LSP about half the time on reference tasks, unprompted. On edits scored by real test execution the gap is starkest: grep solves multi-file renames perfectly, a location-only LSP fails three-quarters of them by missing a call site, and even a complete, index-warmed, text-enriched LSP (each reference's line inline, as production LSP-MCP servers do) recovers most of the gap but cannot close it, since a rename must touch comments and strings that semantic references exclude. The implication is not LSP-always but an adaptive router keyed on task class, model capability, and lexical noise.
title_es: Language Server Protocol ahorra tokens en agentes de código
bajada: Un estudio examina si usar LSP (Language Server Protocol) reduce tokens en agentes de IA para programación versus búsqueda léxica simple. Los resultados muestran que LSP frecuentemente cuesta más tokens, no menos, según el caso de uso.
bajada_en: A study examines whether using LSP (Language Server Protocol) reduces tokens in AI coding agents versus simple lexical search. Results show LSP often costs more tokens, not fewer, depending on use case.
